user_text: 现在能再跑一下数据吗？
scope: One run of the delivered 22-train-shot prompt on the same 426 test sentences at the official DeepSeek endpoint. Historical reviewer predictions supply the control.
limit_basis: Coordinator applies the prior single-test-arm ceiling to this new run. Four workers and one-second spacing are execution safeguards.
comparison: Exploratory historical paired comparison. Primary macro-F1, paired interval, accuracy corrections/regressions, both directions of definition/permission confusion and the previously identified 17-case family. Retain all 426 including parse failures.
